property_summary: An unminted token id can never become owned: any transferFrom on an id with zero address owner must revert and leave it unminted; the mutant drops the WRONG_FROM check so a caller passing from==msg.sender successfully mints ownership of an unminted id.
change_summary: Remove the `WRONG_FROM` requirement so transferFrom can overwrite `_ownerOf[id]` for any id, including unminted ones.
